description: This file contains a jQuery plugin implementation for dynamic pagination controls, including functions for rendering navigation elements, formatting numbers, and handling user interactions for pagination within a web UI.

methods.name: simple_pagination_navigation
methods.description: Generates and inserts HTML for pagination navigation controls dynamically based on current settings.

methods.name: simple_number_formatter
methods.description: Formats numbers with specified decimal places, thousands separator, and decimal separator for display.

methods.name: refresh_page
methods.description: Shows or hides items based on the current page and item range.

methods.name: refresh_first
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'First' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_previous
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'Previous' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_next
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'Next' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_last
methods.description: Creates HTML for the 'Last' page navigation button.

methods.name: refresh_page_numbers
methods.description: Generates HTML for page number links, centered around the current page.

methods.name: refresh_items_per_page_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for selecting items per page.

methods.name: refresh_specific_page_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for selecting a specific page.

methods.name: refresh_simple_pagination
methods.description: Main function to update pagination controls and displayed items based on current page.
